objects.description: [GlassWorm](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9010) has leveraged blockchain-based C2 infrastructure to include Solana blockchain that contains additional C2 details within the memo field.(Citation: Koi Glassworm New Tricks December 2025)(Citation: Koi Glassworm Extensions November 2025)(Citation: Koi Glassworm InvisibleCode October 2025)(Citation: Aikido GlassWorm October 2025)(Citation: Socket GlassWorm January 2026)(Citation: Koi GlassWorm Rust December 2025)  [GlassWorm](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9010) has also leveraged Google Calendar to host encoded data.(Citation: Koi Glassworm InvisibleCode October 2025)(Citation: Socket GlassWorm January 2026)(Citation: Koi GlassWorm Rust December 2025)
objects.description_fa: [GlassWorm](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9010) زیرساخت C2 مبتنی بر بلاک چین را برای گنجاندن بلاک چین Solana که حاوی جزئیات اضافی C2 در یادداشت است، به کار گرفته است. فیلد.(Citation: Koi Glassworm New Tricks December 2025)(Citation: Koi Glassworm Extensions November 2025)(Citation: Koi Glassworm InvisibleCode October 2025)(Citation: Aikido GlassWorm October 2025)(Citation: Socket GlassWorm January 2026)(Citation: Koi GlassWorm Rust December 2025) [[CTI_PRESERVE_1]]]][CTI_PRESERVE_2][[CTI_PRESERVE_2]] از تقویم Google برای میزبانی داده های رمزگذاری شده استفاده کرد.(Citation: Koi Glassworm InvisibleCode October 2025)(Citation: Socket GlassWorm January 2026)(Citation: Koi GlassWorm Rust December 2025)
